description: Adversarial review of the code-gaps change (ADRs 0025-0027) and its fixes: transport-error accounting, in-memory settlement, size-error text and telemetry, the shutdown budget, publish logs, exchange types, SafeLogger and log forging. Integration filters need Docker.

mutants.name: consumer channel ignores whether its connection is open
base HandleBasicCancelAsync not called (consumer not marked cancelled)
ConnectionFailed counted also when the caller cancelled
mutants.find:
await new Connection(amqp, publishers, confirmed).DisposeAsync();
            if (ex is OperationCanceledException

mutants.name: in-memory delivery settles even when nothing settled it (cancelled or failed pipeline)
in-memory dead-letter not marked handled (never settled)
mutants.find:
Handled = true;
            owner.DeadLetter(envelope, reason, settle: false);

mutants.name: in-memory completion not marked handled (never settled)
in-memory delivery never settles in finally
in-memory batch validated while enqueuing
RabbitMQ batch validated while sending
in-memory size checked after telemetry start (refused publish gets a span/metric)
size error omits batch outcome
mutants.find: var outcome = batchIndex is null ? "it was not published" : "no message of the batch was published";

mutants.name: RabbitMQ single publish off by one
HostOptions type name wrong (check silently disabled)
RabbitMQ does not expose its budget
ASB does not expose its budget
in-memory single publish logged before enqueue
mutants.find:
Enqueue(message, body, messageId, options, trace);
        PublishLog.Published(logger, messageId, publishTarget.Destination);
mutants.replace:
PublishLog.Published(logger, messageId, publishTarget.Destination);
        Enqueue(message, body, messageId, options, trace);
mutants.equivalent: Enqueue cannot fail once the publish passed its checks (disposal is checked before), and the logger is a SafeLogger, so logging before or after the enqueue is indistinguishable

mutants.name: headers not a built-in exchange type
exchange type error drops the offending value
in-memory logger not wrapped in SafeLogger
RabbitMQ logger not wrapped in SafeLogger
reschedule does not hold the queue busy
